# jaspervpl.com

> Personal site of Jasper van Puffelen López, AI engineer at NOBRAINERS. He takes AI to production with a method: spec first, human review always. Content in English, Spanish and Dutch.

## English
- [Home](https://jaspervpl.com/): who he is, how he works and his stack
- [Projects](https://jaspervpl.com/projects/): apps, applied AI and Mac utilities, each with its problem, decisions and result
- [Writing](https://jaspervpl.com/writing/): articles on applied AI and the archive from his marketing years
- [Resources](https://jaspervpl.com/resources/): open tools to download and adapt
- [Reading](https://jaspervpl.com/reading/): the books that shaped him
